title: Schur stability conjecture for image reconstruction operators
statement:
Let $W$ be a primitive stochastic matrix, let $B$ be a positive semidefinite matrix satisfying

$$
Be \leqslant \varrho(B)e
$$

and

$$
\pi^\top Be>0,
$$

where $\pi$ is the left Perron eigenvector of $W$. Define

$$
P(t)=W(I-tB),\qquad R(t)=I-W+(I+tB)^{-1}(2W-I).
$$

**Schur stability conjecture.** The operators $P(t)$ and $R(t)$ are stable, meaning that

$$
\varrho(P(t))<1\quad\text{and}\quad\varrho(R(t))<1,
$$

for all $0<t<2/\varrho(B)$.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.06715

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2025).
source_name: Debraj Banerjee and Kunal Narayan Chaudhury, “On the Schur Stability of Some Image Reconstruction Operators”, arXiv:2509.06715 (2025).
